item.title: A message from Mr. Cornellier and Mr. Letendre.
item.description: The first junior and senior girls' volleyball tryout will be held today after school from 2:20 to 3:45.

item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: The coaches would like to congratulate the junior girls' basketball team for two dominating wins vs Russell High and VCI. The girls are improving in all aspects of the game. Next up is an exhibition game against the PRBC Rockets U19 team this coming Monday night at 745 pm at St. FX. Their next league game is at home against Le Sommet next Wednesday. Great job girls!

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Curtis -
item.description: Grade 8 girls signed up for the Skilled Trades Workshops are asked to please return their permission forms to Mrs. Curtis by Monday, October 19 to keep their spots.

item.title: A Message from: Mme Perron-
item.description: Mme Perron and Mme Bourdon are happy to announce that one final seat has opened up on our flight to Paris in April. If you're a high school student interested in joining 30 other students and staff from STA to celebrate the end of the fighting at Vimy Ridge and Passchendaele or want to buy your mom some fancy jewels or designer purses on Les Champs de Lysee or see Leonardo Da Vinci's Mona Lisa up close in person or tour the Eiffle Tower please see Mme Perron sometime today as the ticket will be released on a first come first reserved basis on the online system. Students must have valid passports in order to apply.

item.title: A message from: Ms. Bradley
item.description: Students in grades 9-12 who are interested in participating in this years University of Waterloo math contests need to sign up in room #207 today at lunch.

item.title: A message from:
item.description: Mme. Perron a reminder to all CURRENT EUROPE TEAM TRAVELERS to be at the Russell Arena tomorrow afternoon at 230 pm if you signed up to help set up for trivia night otherwise all travelers are asked to meet upstairs at the Russell Arena at 7.pm sharp
